The Dean and Hunter plot line has me crashing out a bit as a fan of the books. Hunter and Dean were good friends in the book and Dean was the reason Hunter returned to hockey since he stopped once he got to Briar, not Tucker and Logan. Hunter never slept with Allie, since Allie is a relationship girly and didn’t hook up like in the show.  Hunter in the Briar U book series actually has a massive crush on Dean’s sister Summer, but from the looking of where they are going, they are setting up that Hunter probably dated or slept with Summer and it didn’t end well. But the plot with Dean and Allie is extremely messed up now and is the biggest problem for me with this show. Originally their relationship takes place a year after Hannah and Garrett get together and takes place in the 3rd book called The Score and them getting together was a big surprise to Hannah, Garrett, Logan and Tucker, given who Allie is and given who Dean is. But instead,  60% of The Score’s plot takes place in Ep.6 of S1 in the first 15 minutes. So as a fan of the books, I’m so lost as to what they are planning with those two and Hunter now which assuming will be continuing in S2 and the main plot for S3. This show is accurate to the books, and totally off par too, it’s so confusing and conflicting.
